SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count, AVG(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_process_time IS NOT NULL AND monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_complete_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_process_time, monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_complete_time) / 1000 ELSE NULL END) as avg_process_duration_ms, AVG(CASE WHEN monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_create_time IS NOT NULL AND monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_process_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_create_time, monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue_process_time) / 1000 ELSE NULL END) as avg_wait_duration_ms FROM monitor_sys_gen_server_file_upload_queue WHERE monitor_sys_gen_server_id = #{serverId}
